{{Top}}
A '''survival kit''' was one of the things found inside a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] or [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. It contained a number of items like [[Ration bar/Legends|ration bars]] or [[medkit]]s that would be needed in order for the user to survive until rescued. They also tended to carry a [[survival knife]], sometimes a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], a thermal blanket, a [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrod]], [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hooks]], [[stimpill]]s, high tension wire and other survival items.<ref name="rebirth">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref>
